verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents its own 'advanced call activity with history and trends' in its app and dashboard, and business plans let admins add users and manage every number. That is a thin basis for call-volume reporting. However, the trends feature appears in consumer plan descriptions, and missed-call alerts are notifications rather than reports. missing for 10: answer-rate metrics, missed-call reporting, per-number breakdowns, per-teammate breakdowns, any business analytics documentation or independent corroboration.
